name: NaviGates
description: A benchmark that measures indoor navigation performance (path planning, localization, and navigation robustness) across realistic indoor environments and sensor modalities.
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark for indoor navigation used in robotics research, though less widely adopted than larger simulation suites (e.g., Habitat).
notes: Covers multiple sensor modalities and realistic indoor environments; results can be sensitive to sim-to-real gaps and sensor configuration. Dataset size and environment diversity may limit generalization.
